title: HECAVEX Labs changes
description: Meaningful dataset additions, corrections, schema changes and workspace lifecycle changes.

items.title: Europe actor context and Hostinger pivot published
items.content_text: The Atlas gained an explicitly bounded Europe-context actor layer, ATT&CK Evidence was rebuilt from APT Notes 2.2.0, and the Pivot Workspace gained a Hostinger-themed Pages phishing graph.

items.title: Labs narrowed to three first-class workspaces
items.content_text: Baltic Threat Atlas and Evidence Pivot remain primary. ATT&CK is refocused on reviewed evidence. Generic OSINT and earlier operational ATT&CK material are retained as archived records.

items.title: Adform supply-chain clipper case graph published
items.content_text: A versioned evidence graph separates captured JavaScript, reproducible transformations, public-chain observations and bounded assessments.

items.title: Dataset lifecycle fields made public
items.content_text: Catalogue records gained ownership, review triggers, archive conditions and explicit lifecycle states.
